liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (3 reviews): Bobby responds to the 'sky with flame' line with 'Check it out!', acknowledging the colorful sky; Estimated Prophet into Eyes Of The World was especially good to this reviewer [13][17][21]
- **The Other One** (1 review, 1 other source): The Other One is judged one of the best of the 1980s, as is Dear Mr. Fantasy; The Other One includes its space segment within the track [7][14]
- **Box Of Rain** (2 reviews): Box of Rain as encore was a distinguishing touch for touring fans, signaling a special show; The show closed with a Box of Rain encore [14][19]
- **Touch Of Gray** (1 review): Touch Of Gray features deep Brent keyboard colors and delicate vocals from Jerry, though the energy sags as it proceeds [15]
- **Loser** (1 review): Loser is played in an appropriately moody fashion [15]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The crowd goes wild at one point during Fire On The Mountain [10]

## The recordings

- **gd87-06-30.matrix.hinko.13442.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 155 min; rated 4.32/5 by 31 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording and mix sound average; Jerry is hard to hear at all [16]
- **gd1987-06-30.sbd-mtx.hinko.tetzeli.34404.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 24 songs; 155 min; rated 3.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd87-06-30.schoeps.ladner.8577.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 25 songs; 155 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [6]. Said about its sound: Excellent audience recording with plenty of Phil in the mix [21]
- **gd1987-06-30.148702.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 24 songs; 158 min [7]
- **gd1987-06-30.136770.aud.jc.flac16**: audience recording; 12 songs; 91 min [9]

## Around the show

- The sky turned an unusually strange color during Scarlet Begonias, fitting the lyric about a yellow sky; many attendees remarked on it [10]
- A strange noise during drums, like gas, was actually a motorcycle miked up on stage [10]
- Kingswood sits inside Canada's Wonderland amusement park about an hour north of Toronto, dominated by a man-made mountain [13]
- The colorful sky made it seem like there was a fire on the mountain, matching the park's artificial mountain [13]
- Reviewer traveled from NYC and considered Kingswood an especially unusual venue for a show [19]
- Reviewer calls it one of the best shows of 1987, with the whole second set ripping [14]
- Called the dark horse of 1987 shows, often overlooked [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-06-30.matrix.hinko.13442.sbeok.shnf**: source: Ultra Matrix MSC>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN (Seekable) [1]. Also: Primary source is an Ultra Matrix, copied via DAT and CDR to SHN, with an audience patch [1]
- **gd1987-06-30.sbd-mtx.hinko.tetzeli.34404.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko and Bill Tetzeli; source: Ultra Matrix MSC>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN (Seekable) [2]. Also: Patches from an audience source (8577) fix noise and a cut in the transition between discs [2]
- **gd87-06-30.schoeps.ladner.8577.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD (mic. unk) > DAT > CDR > SHN [6]
- **gd1987-06-30.148702.fob.senn.me80.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser ME-80 mics > Sony D5M [7]. Also: Master cassette from Michael Hessberg, transferred by Charlie Miller, with Schoeps patches from Chris Ladner and pitch correction help [7]
- **gd1987-06-30.136770.aud.jc.flac16**: taped by unknown; transferred by jchastain; source: Set 2 only - Audience > unknown > cassette (John) > Sony TC-R303 > Zoom h4n > Audition CC 2015 > shntool > TLH [9]. Also: This audience tape came from a collection of tapes given away on craigslist [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Kingswood Music Theatre - June 30, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/june-30-1987) [23]
